learnedInstincts.lesson: Migrate from StateProvider to NotifierProvider in Riverpod 3.x with explicit semantic mutation methods (.unlock, .add, .toggle).
Use .safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom) instead of manual padding or Spacers to guarantee perfect placement above tab bars and home indicators.
Never use flat gray boxes or harsh drop shadows. Use the Double-Bezel (Doppelrand) architecture with outer ring, inner porcelain core, and diffused ambient shadows.
Gelly, Bloop, Pip, Mochi, and Spark form a warm, funny, brilliant creative agency squad. They bounce ideas off each other in real-time.
Follow the 18-second formula: 0-2.5s Disruption Hook, 2.5-5s Pain Point, 5-9s Magic Reveal, 9-14s Kinetic UI Proof, 14-18s Brand CTA.
Strictly decouple UI/Presentation, Notifiers, Domain Entities, and Repositories. Always write a failing test before writing implementation logic.
Avoid hardcoded static mock data. Refactor seed generators to accept dynamic parameters like gender, location, and category for realistic testing.
Resolve 'resource fork, Finder information, or similar detritus not allowed' errors by running xattr -cr across the project root.
